SEC seeks court order forcing ISS to hand over client voting data
news.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has asked a federal court to compel Institutional Shareholder Services to provide detailed client voting records as part of an investigation into the proxy advisory firm’s practices, Bloomberg reported on Saturday.
